remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Whitney Museum. May 1946. . . . Note: Probably ptd. ab. 1915 or 1916." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates "Back: An American Place stamp top and bottom. Label: Whitney Museum, 1946 label" [neither verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, March 1958." Whitney Archive dates 1915. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1917. Dated spring 1918 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Tree and Earth

description: Twisting, abstract forms in shades of dark green fill the canvas. These forms resemble leaves or clusters pine needles, while brown shapes look like twisted trunks and tree branches. These abstract tree shapes merge with light brown earth below and pale blue sky above.
title: Tree and Earth
